sentence: This project studies how genetic differences between people change enhancer activity in breast cancer and how inflammatory signaling adds to this.
This project tries to find out how early embryos organize their first cell layers and make their first choices about cell types.
This project tries to find out how a protein in neutrophils makes thrombosis worse in people with lung cancer.
This project builds a fast knee MRI scan that uses deep learning to show the whole knee and measure joint damage.
This project studies how extreme heat and air pollution, including wildfire smoke, affect the health of older people with Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.
This project looks for a target for treatment in diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma, a brainstem tumor in children.
This project studies how the centromere is maintained and how it helps chromosomes separate.
This project uses computer simulations and artificial intelligence tools to model how cells sense force, change shape, move and send signals.
This project uses computed and experimental protein structures to study protein families that matter for cancer development and treatment.
This project tries to find out which host and bacterial factors cause an imbalance in the vaginal microbiome.
This project tests whether lowering a trafficking protein helps in mice with inherited dilated cardiomyopathy.
This project uses electrophysiology in mouse models to find out whether a signature in the spiking of cerebellar nuclei neurons drives dystonia.
This project develops an intelligent ultrafast bioimaging program.
This project studies how cocaine self-administration changes cholinergic signaling and the ability to update behavior during reversal learning.
This project shares tools and ideas from immunoengineering so that immunologists and engineers can work together.
This project studies how glucocorticoids and their signaling affect oral cancer development and how gallic acid changes this pathway.
This project holds a meeting where scientists discuss uses of ultrasound imaging, such as lung ultrasound and wearable ultrasound.
This project tests a type of immunotherapy for ocular surface squamous neoplasia and studies how it works.
This project tests a vaccine approach that uses nanoparticles carrying HIV-1 envelope proteins to help the body make broadly neutralizing antibodies.
This project studies how mitochondria are regulated and how this shapes cell lineage and cell function.
